## Shared context (verbatim, immutable)

# Verification-integrity final full review

Review the complete `06efaae43c0f343efc6e2bb6c289b907b218b9be..47f6d18f719a6b5ec20774a82bc0d0e3bf338fad` diff and every changed file read-only. The implementer is Kimi; this review covers verification-infrastructure contracts, Python implementation and tests, review instructions, and the temporarily stale ledger note that will be corrected after final assurance.

Settled earlier findings, all with before-failing and after-passing regressions:
- Imported, aliased, decorated, and wildcard pytest suppressions are resolved; combined wildcard imports from both pytest and pytest.mark now retain every source.
- Comments cannot hide equal operands; exact string/regex literal whitespace remains significant.
- Repeated calls and other potentially side-effecting operands are not assumed equal.
- TypeScript expect toBe/toEqual/toStrictEqual scans cover nonliteral self-comparisons and trailing commas.
- Whole newly allocated object/array/regex literals are exempt only for identity matchers; member expressions and deep-equality structural comparisons remain V5.
- Plain template literals and backticks inside strings are not tagged templates; tagged-template detection uses masked code.
- Java class literals and mixed-quote equivalent strings are V5; generic calls and effectful template substitutions are excluded.
- Function-local non-pytest bindings shadow aliases, while function-local pytest imports remain suppressions.
- Type/non-null suffixes preserve fresh-literal identity semantics.
- The three-model review rule is maintainer-directed and settled.
- GitHub server enforcement and ledger correction are tracked separately; do not re-report them as repository-code findings.

The e4814ef9 refactor passed verification with no oracle edits. The final refactoring run applied only mechanical renames in ece0c43e and verified no oracle edits with growth ratio 0.1656; structural suggestions rejected for growth ratio, unnecessary abstraction, or V4 caller attribution are settled. Focus on concrete behavioral defects, contract drift, ineffective tests, baseline subtraction, parsing offsets, alias scoping, and equality semantics. Return at most five findings with triggers and observable consequences, or an empty findings list promptly.

summary: 已只读审查完整变更及验证契约，重点复现了 pytest 别名作用域、TypeScript 参数切分和相等语义边界。变更总体方向正确，但仍存在 3 个可绕过 V3/V5 的漏报和 2 个阻断合法测试改动的误报；现有回归测试未覆盖这些具体路径。

findings.title: TypeScript 类型参数中的逗号导致 V5 漏报
findings.trigger: 在已有 TypeScript 测试中加入 `expect(value as Foo<Bar, Baz>).toBe(value as Foo<Bar, Baz>)`。
findings.consequence: `split_arguments` 只平衡 `()`、`[]`、`{}`，会把类型参数中的逗号当成 expect 的参数分隔符，得到两个 received 参数；随后 `len(received) != 1` 直接跳过检查，新增的恒真自比较断言不会触发 V5。
findings.evidence: `scripts/check-verification-integrity.py:227-240` 的 `split_arguments` 不跟踪尖括号类型层级；`scripts/check-verification-integrity.py:685-693` 在 received 参数数不等于 1 时跳过 expect 检查。简单类型参数 `Foo<Bar>` 能被检测，但含逗号的合法类型参数会漏报。
findings.suggestedFix: 使用 TypeScript 感知的参数切分或在非比较上下文中平衡尖括号类型参数，并增加 `Foo<Bar, Baz>` 的自比较回归测试。

findings.title: 对象属性名中的关键字被误判为副作用
findings.trigger: 新增深比较断言 `expect({class: "x"}).toEqual({class: "x"})` 或 `assert.deepEqual({delete: true}, {delete: true})`。
findings.consequence: 属性名 `class`、`delete` 等被词法正则识别为构造或更新操作，`c_like_side_effect` 因而返回真，V5 不报告。开发者可加入结构性恒真断言而不被验证完整性门禁拦截。
findings.evidence: `scripts/check-verification-integrity.py:276` 用单词边界匹配 `new|delete|yield|await|function|class`；`scripts/check-verification-integrity.py:284-289` 不区分关键字实际语法位置，导致对象键被当作副作用。
findings.suggestedFix: 使用语法上下文或先屏蔽对象属性键，只把真正的操作符和表达式关键字视为副作用，并增加关键字属性键的深比较测试。

findings.title: 推导式目标错误屏蔽真实 pytest.skip
findings.trigger: 测试中先执行 `[pytest for pytest in []]`，随后执行 `pytest.skip("reason")`；Python 3 的推导式变量不会泄漏到函数作用域，后一个调用仍使用全局 pytest 模块。
findings.consequence: `pytest` 被收集为函数局部绑定，真实 runtime skip 被标记为 shadowed 并从 V3 中排除。测试可被静默跳过而门禁返回成功。
findings.evidence: `scripts/check-verification-integrity.py:503-517` 递归收集所有 `ast.Name(Store)`，包括推导式迭代目标；`scripts/check-verification-integrity.py:526-533` 用该集合抑制调用检查。
findings.suggestedFix: 推导出函数作用域时忽略推导式自身的迭代变量，仅保留会绑定外层作用域的 walrus 等结构，并加入推导式同名变量后的真实 skip 回归测试。

findings.title: pytest 别名表未按词法作用域和绑定顺序解析
findings.trigger: 模块中有 `from pytest import skip as suppress`，随后执行 `suppress = print`，测试内调用 `suppress("ordinary")`；或某个函数局部导入该别名，而兄弟函数调用普通的同名全局函数。
findings.consequence: `ast.walk` 收集的 pytest 别名会泄漏到整个文件并覆盖后续普通绑定，普通调用被误报为 V3，门禁以 1 退出并阻断合法测试改动。
findings.evidence: `scripts/check-verification-integrity.py:469-483` 从整棵树无条件收集最后遇到的 pytest 导入；`scripts/check-verification-integrity.py:523-533` 只检查函数局部绑定，不处理模块级重绑定或导入所在函数的作用域。
findings.suggestedFix: 按词法作用域和作用顺序维护名称绑定，让后续非 pytest 导入或赋值覆盖旧别名，并增加模块级重绑定及跨函数局部导入测试。

findings.title: 索引调用被误判为纯自比较
findings.consequence: 计算属性调用没有被识别为调用，重复调用被当作纯表达式自比较并报告 V5；当调用返回新值或读取可变状态时，这会误阻合法测试。
findings.evidence: `scripts/check-verification-integrity.py:277` 的调用正则只识别标识符和右括号后的 `(`；`scripts/check-verification-integrity.py:284-289` 因此让 `](` 和 `?.[...](` 形式漏过副作用检查。
findings.suggestedFix: 识别右方括号和可选链后的调用运算符，或改用 token/parser 级调用检测，并增加索引调用与可选索引调用回归测试。
